reason: Every boundary bit has its register in RTL: request/return/inject banks are written straight from the pins / seam and read by a mux into a register (serial_rr, stream launch, ijq); every output is a register (ij banks, launch, tap) or the synchroniser / sticky-fault OR. A wrapper stage would move the fixed 3:4 seam calendar (windows 2q..7q) and the VM 10/7 calendar.
